$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (connectors-webshop-orders). The dormant Shopify shop template, its mapping onto shillinq's WebshopOrder and an incremental synchronization of the shop's orders. No code: the synchronization engine does the work.

objects.name: Shopify shop
objects.description: A Shopify store (Admin REST API, https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest). Orders: GET <store>.myshopify.com/admin/api/<version>/orders.json?status=any, at most 250 per call, changed-since filter `updated_at_min`. Auth: an Admin API access token in the `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header, held by the credential broker. The API version is part of the location: set it to https://<store>.myshopify.com/admin/api/2025-07 (or the version your app uses), add the credential, then enable.

objects.name: Shopify order to shillinq WebshopOrder
objects.description: One Shopify order as shillinq's WebshopOrder (shillinq sales-webshop-orders, design D2). Fill `channelId` and `administrationId` with the ids of this shop's WebshopChannel in shillinq (Sales, Web shops): the synchronization does not run while either is empty. The mapping never writes shillinq's own fields (`intakeState`, `arInvoiceId`, `creditNoteId`, `refusalReason`). `payment.status` is paid, pending, refunded or cancelled; a later fetch of the same order updates it on the same object.

mapping.buyer.name: {{ billing_address.name|default('') }}
mapping.lines: {{ line_items|map(l => {sku: l.sku|default(''), description: l.title, quantity: l.quantity, unitPrice: (l.price + 0)|round(2), vatRate: ((l.tax_lines[0].rate|default(0)) * 100)|round(0)})|json_encode }}
mapping.payment.status: {{ cancelled_at is not empty or financial_status == 'voided' ? 'cancelled' : (financial_status == 'refunded' ? 'refunded' : (financial_status in ['paid', 'partially_refunded'] ? 'paid' : 'pending')) }}

objects.name: Shopify orders to shillinq
objects.description: Writes the Shopify shop's orders into shillinq as one WebshopOrder each, incrementally: each run asks only for orders changed since the last complete run (`updated_at_min`, read from each order's `updated_at`; a run fetches at most 250 orders and the next run continues from the last one), and the cursor moves only after a complete fetch. Each order is kept on its shop order id, so a later refund or cancellation updates the payment status of the WebshopOrder already written and never makes a second one. Nothing is deleted. Off until the source and the mapping's channel and administration ids are filled.

requiredMappingValues.name: the shillinq WebshopChannel id of this Shopify shop
the shillinq administration id of this Shopify shop
